sam: Quick postmortem follow-up for INC-2026-0601. Noticed recurring latency spikes during autoscaler churn. Need to agree temporary SLOs and owners.
sam: Proposal: bump p95 from 140ms -> 210ms for 28 days, with checkpoints at 72h and 14d. Rollback if p95 < 165ms for 7 consecutive days.
anna (SRE): Fine with that window. Also propose tightening the throughput SLO evaluation window from 60s to 30s during the temp period to avoid penalizing brief bursts.
mei: I'll own dashboards/runbook. Will add p95, p99, and per-pool QPS, plus annotations for canary start/stop. PR will include alert thresholds.
rajesh: I'll take autoscaler tuning and the canary rollout. Plan: smooth scale-up, increase cool-down, staged pool rollout. Canary in 4 days.
sre-bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-2026-0601-FOLLOWUP (#4120) and linked postmortem.
sam: Action list (please ack):
- Dashboard + runbook (48h): mei
- Canary autoscaler rollout (start in 4d): rajesh
- Kernel perf probe (2w): anna (SRE)
- Customer comms draft (72h): sam
- Update SLO governance & add rollback rules (5d): sam
mei: ack. Dashboard PR will include PromQL for p95 and p99 by pool.
anna (SRE): ack. Adding a 99p alarm and a short-run panic playbook to the runbook.
rajesh: ack. Canary will abort if p99 > 500ms for 10m; rollback steps in runbook.
sam: Thanks all. Please put a one-line "owned" when you create PR/ticket links so I can close assignments in #4120.
mei: owned (PR #1021).
rajesh: owned (canary plan in ticket).
anna (SRE): owned (kernel probe ticket linked).
sre-bot: Follow-up checklist updated in #4120.
sam: I'll schedule the 14-day debrief now. If anyone needs to swap, update the ticket or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
